kicker: NEVER RUN OUT OF THINGS TO SAY
title: 4 ways to keep a conversation *going*

text: She tells you a story. You say "oh nice." *Conversation over.*

items.head: Ask how they felt
items.sub: "How did you feel about that?" beats "oh nice."

items.head: Ask how it started
items.sub: "How did you get into that?" There's always a story.

items.head: Repeat their last words
items.sub: "Problems with your sister?" They'll explain on their own.

items.head: Ask what happened next
items.sub: "Then what?" Shows you actually want the rest.

head: Same story, two replies
r: "Wait, how did you get into that?"

text: You don't need better stories. You need *better follow-ups.*
